description.value: Kennedy's Sports Pub is a North Delta institution that has been welcoming locals since 1979, seating over 200 guests across a main room, a darts game room, a dance floor, and an outdoor patio with both covered and uncovered sections. The kitchen turns out a broad all-day menu—from breakfast through burgers, pasta, wings, and weekend brunch—supported by a full bar and weekly entertainment including live bands, trivia, and bingo nights. A separately operated Kennedy's Liquor, Beer & Wine Store sits about one block away.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at kennedyssportspub.com is fully accessible and confirms the pub address (11906 88 Ave, Delta, BC) and provides a phone number (604-590-2366) absent from OSM. The About Us page explicitly mentions complimentary WiFi and an outdoor patio with covered and uncovered sections; the menu shows vegetarian options (Veggie Quesadilla, Veggie Benny). No bike-specific amenities (parking, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site, and no takeout service is explicitly described.
concerns: OSM name is 'Kennedy's Pub' but the website consistently uses 'Kennedy's Sports Pub' across all pages and in the domain name; updated to website value.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, long-established pub with an active website, confirmed address, and full food and drink service — straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Kennedy's Liquor, Beer & Wine Store is a related but separate location approximately one block away at 8899 120 Street, Delta, BC.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Veggie Quesadilla and Veggie Benny; vegetarian options present across multiple menu sections

wow_evidence: North Delta institution that has been welcoming locals since 1979
